examples.arabic: هو دلوقتي بيشتغل في مدرسة كبيرة
examples.english: He now works in a big school.
examples.transliteration: howa delwaaty biyeshtaghal fi madrasa kebeera

examples.english: Then her kids returned from the school.
examples.transliteration: baaden weladha rejou men el madrasa

examples.arabic: اليوم في المدرسة كان فيه مدرس جديد
examples.english: Today at school there was a new teacher.
examples.transliteration: El-yoom fel madrasa kan feeh modarres gedid

examples.arabic: سأل تاني إمتى هو كمان هيروح المدرسة وإمتى هيخلص لعب
examples.english: He asked again, "When will he also go to school and when will he finish playing?"
examples.transliteration: Sa'al taany emta howwa kamaan hayrouh elmadrasa weemta hayekhallas la'b.

examples.arabic: و بتسأل اختي مريم هتروح المدرسة ازاي النهاردة
examples.english: And she asks my sister Maryam how she will go to school today.
examples.transliteration: W betesal okhti Maryam hatrouḥ el madrasa ezay el naharda

examples.english: Then I go to school with my friends.
examples.transliteration: Ba3dein baro7 el madrasa ma3 so7abi.
